args.sql: SELECT * FROM technicalinfo LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    a.accindex,
    a.platident,
    sd.detection_score_profile->'behavior_scores'->>'botlikscore' as botlikscore,
    sd.detection_score_profile->'behavior_scores'->>'autobehavscore' as autobehavscore,
    ma.convnatval
FROM account a
JOIN profile p ON p.profaccref = a.accindex
JOIN sessionbehavior sb ON sb.sessprofref = p.profkey
JOIN networkmetrics nm ON nm.netsessref = sb.sessref
JOIN technicalinfo ti ON ti.technetref = nm.netkey
JOIN securitydetection sd ON sd.sectechref = ti.techkey
JOIN messaginganalysis ma ON ma.msgkey = ti.techmsgref
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    sd.detection_score_profile->'behavior_scores'->>'botlikscore' as botlikscore_raw,
    sd.detection_score_profile->'behavior_scores'->>'autobehavscore' as autobehavscore,
    ma.convnatval,
    (CAST(sd.detection_score_profile->'behavior_scores'->>'botlikscore' AS numeric) / 100.0) as botlikscore_norm,
    0.4 * (CAST(sd.detection_score_profile->'behavior_scores'->>'botlikscore' AS numeric) / 100.0) + 0.3 * CAST(sd.detection_score_profile->'behavior_scores'->>'autobehavscore' AS numeric) + 0.3 * (1 - ma.convnatval) as bbi
FROM account a
JOIN profile p ON p.profaccref = a.accindex
JOIN sessionbehavior sb ON sb.sessprofref = p.profkey
JOIN networkmetrics nm ON nm.netsessref = sb.sessref
JOIN technicalinfo ti ON ti.technetref = nm.netkey
JOIN securitydetection sd ON sd.sectechref = ti.techkey
JOIN messaginganalysis ma ON ma.msgkey = ti.techmsgref
LIMIT 5;

WITH account_bbi AS (
    SELECT 
        a.accindex,
        a.platident,
        0.4 * (CAST(sd.detection_score_profile->'behavior_scores'->>'botlikscore' AS numeric) / 100.0) 
        + 0.3 * CAST(sd.detection_score_profile->'behavior_scores'->>'autobehavscore' AS numeric) 
        + 0.3 * (1 - ma.convnatval) as bbi
    FROM account a
    JOIN profile p ON p.profaccref = a.accindex
    JOIN sessionbehavior sb ON sb.sessprofref = p.profkey
    JOIN networkmetrics nm ON nm.netsessref = sb.sessref
    JOIN technicalinfo ti ON ti.technetref = nm.netkey
    JOIN securitydetection sd ON sd.sectechref = ti.techkey
    JOIN messaginganalysis ma ON ma.msgkey = ti.techmsgref
),
cluster_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        platident as cluster_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT accindex) as clustsize,
        ROUND(AVG(bbi)::numeric, 4) as avg_bbi
    FROM account_bbi
    GROUP BY platident
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT accindex) > 10 AND AVG(bbi) > 0.7
)
SELECT 
    cs.cluster_id,
    cs.clustsize,
    cs.avg_bbi,
    cs.clustsize as total_account_count
FROM cluster_stats cs
ORDER BY cs.avg_bbi DESC;
